source.ref: Karnataka Stamp Act, 1957, Sch. Art. 40-A (Constitution) (amounts subst. by Act 15 of 2012 / Act 8 of 2003)
source.quoted_text: Sch Art. 40 (both columns): 'Partnership — A. Instrument of Constitution — (a) Where the capital of the partnership does not exceed rupees fifty thousand — five hundred rupees; (b) In any other case — two thousand rupees. B. Reconstitution — (a) where immovable property contributed as share ... remains with the firm at outgoing — 3% on the market value ...; (b) in any other case — one thousand rupees. C. Dissolution — (a) where property ... is distributed/alloted to another partner — 3% on the market value ...; (b) in any other case — one thousand rupees.'

notes_for_reviewer: CONFIDENCE: HIGH (official DPAL). Constitution of partnership: capital ≤ Rs 50,000 → Rs 500; else → Rs 2,000. Karnataka has a SEPARATE LLP article (40A: constitution Rs 1,000 ≤Rs 10L, then Rs 500 per Rs 5L slab above, max Rs 10L) — NOT encoded here: the 'Rs 500 for every Rs 5 lakh or part thereof' step needs a ceil/slab-count value primitive (wave 3). Reconstitution (B) and Dissolution (C) 3%-on-property cases also deferred (need the property-value base + the 'in addition to' dissolution rule).
